decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (330200/SLP/001. Received: 24/02/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Unit 1 hereby permitted shall be used for the retail sale of DIY goods; building products; home furnishings; products for the maintenance and improvement or cars; the sale of bicycles; accessories and ancillary products for cars and bicycles; office supplies, equipment and furniture; carpets and floor coverings; and other bulky products for related purposes and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A1 of the schedule of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order)'.
Unit 2 hereby permitted shall be used for the sale of all food and drink and non-food goods, with food not to exceed 30% of the total gross retail floorspace of the unit.
description: Variation of condition 1 to allow a discount variety operator to occupy unit 2 following planning permission 00628/B/P6 dated 13/8/1996 for alterations to elevations and variation of condition 3 to widen the range of goods allowed to be sold (to include sale of bicycles,floor coverings, office supplies and products for the maintenance andimprovement of the car, accessories for cars and bicycles and ancillary products
